report:
In the CRANIAL MRI examination:
Technique: Axial plane FSE T2 and FLAIR T2, coronal plane FSE T1, and sagittal plane FSE T2.

Examination;
	Bony structures and subgaleal tissue included in the field of view are normal.
In the evaluation of craniofacial structures; the nasal cavity, paranasal sinuses, and mastoid air cells are normal.

	In the evaluation of the orbits included in the field of view; the globes, extraorbital muscles, retrobulbar fat, and optic nerves were evaluated as normal.

In the posterior fossa series; the fourth ventricle is of normal location, shape, and size. Cerebellar hemispheres are observed symmetrically; gray-white matter differentiation shows no specific features.
	Brainstem structures, pons, and midbrain are normal.
	Basal cisterns are observed as patent.

	In the supratentorial series; white and gray matter intensities in both hemispheres are observed as normal. The ventricular system is symmetric on the midline and is of age-appropriate size.
	Basal ganglia and thalami are normal.
	Cortical sulci and gyri are regular.

Impression: Brain MRI findings within normal limits.
